item.title: 1. A private conversation
item.description: 要求 内化单词 + 语法 + 习惯用法。 听力 + 口语 + 写作练习 Bilibili 1. 课文 Last week, I went to the theater. I had a very good seat. The play was interesting. But I did not enjoy it. A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me. They were talking loudly. I got very angry. I could not hear the actors.

item.title: 2. comprehension
item.description: comprehend the article, repeat it with key words , then paragraph it with your own words 5. Comprehension (理解) 根据课文提问并回答。 自问自答。 6. Asking questions. As me if What/ When/ How … ? Is / Does … Practice 2 They were talking loudly. (how) How were they talking. I couldn’t hear the actors.
